title: Filipino Fried Noodles
description: A simple and flavorful Filipino-inspired dish made with stir-fried noodles and vegetables. Serve hot and enjoy!
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the chopped crispy fried shallots and stir-fry for another minute.
Add the rice noodles and stir-fry until they are well coated with the oil and mixture.
Add the zesty soy sauce and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the noodles to a serving plate and serve hot.
